name: DCA Lucky Fortune Cookery Beef Bulgogi & Steamed Jasmine White Rice Bowl
whyItWorks: Thinly shaved tender ribeye marinated in sweet soy and garlic, wok-seared and served over fluffy steamed jasmine white rice. High in bioavailable heme iron and easily digested carbs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Beef Bulgogi Bowl with steamed white rice; request vegetables soft or hold raw green onions.
